_team_scope_note: PMN records the team in two different fields depending on issue type: cf[10040] 'Epic Team' is set on epics, cf[10098] 'Team Name' on stories/bugs/tasks. The real Jira value is "The Fellowship of Metrics" -- a plain 'Fellowship' search returns 0. any_clause is the union (168 via cf[10040], 974 via cf[10098], 1120 union); bug_clause is what bugs actually carry -- confirmed 0 bugs have cf[10040] set, matching the Ascenders pattern.

team_scope.name: Fellowship
team_scope.any_clause: (cf[10040] = "The Fellowship of Metrics" OR cf[10098] = "The Fellowship of Metrics")

_forecast_note: Kobi asked (2026-08-30) for a forecast based on the last 2 releases only, not the full 5-release regression: 25.3/25.4/26.1 were all 0 for this team, so including them would dilute the trend into meaninglessness (same reasoning already applied to CXCO and Ascenders). Linear fit over just 26.2 (8) and 26.3 (17): slope +9/release, forecast for 26.4 = 26.
forecast_basis: linear extrapolation over the last 2 releases (26.2 to 26.3)
_recipients_note: Recipient addresses are NOT in this file -- the repo is public. They come from the FELLOWSHIP_DASHBOARD_RECIPIENTS secret (semicolon-separated); the test audience comes from PMN_DASHBOARD_TEST_RECIPIENT.
